subject: Sponsor prebrief alignment request — reschedule to match CTO window
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmetech.com>
To: rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: R&D Ops <ops@acmetech.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 15:02:23 -0400
Subject: Request: shift technical panel to fit CTO runway

Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for putting the technical panel on the calendar. Our CTO's travel just shifted unexpectedly; they're available for a short prebrief window on Wed 1 Sep between 11:00–11:40 AM PDT and then have to hop on a flight. Would it be possible to move the demo to start at 11:00 so the CTO can join the first 25–30 minutes?

If that won't work, we can have our VP of Eng join instead and have the CTO dial in for the last 15 minutes, but preference is to have the CTO at the top.

Also would like a 20–30 minute prebrief with the engineering leads the morning of Sep 1 if you have availability.

Appreciate the flexibility — Priya

--
Priya Shah
Head of Platform, Acme Technologies
priya.shah@acmetech.com

From: rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: shift technical panel to fit CTO runway

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the heads up and congrats on the CT O's new travel schedule (ow!). We can accommodate — options below:

- Move the main demo to Wed Sep 1, 11:00 AM PDT (current team available). CTO would be able to join right at the top for ~25–30 mins. We'll compress the walkthrough: 20 minutes on runtime performance, 10 minutes demo Q&A, and leave the last 10 for CT O-specific questions.
- If you prefer keeping the original slot, we can have our VP-level engineer cover the first 40 minutes and have the CTO join for the closing 15.

Camila (SE) and Sean (CS) are cc'd — Camila will attach an updated agenda (agenda_v2.pdf) and confirm whether the engineering lead needs any prebrief materials.

Also happy to do a 30-minute prebrief with your engineers at 9:30 AM PDT on Sep 1 if that works. If you'd prefer a different time, tell us and we'll adjust.

Best,

Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com
From: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmetech.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: shift technical panel to fit CTO runway

Thanks Rachel — attaching agenda_v2.pdf (stub: 120KB).

Quick note on sequencing: our CTO-level reviewer (internal) asked to be looped in, but Marcus is traveling and won't be back until Sep 2. To ensure we keep the session tight and technically useful, proposed plan:

1) Start demo at 11:00 AM PDT on Sep 1. Marcus (engineering manager) will join via phone for the first 15 minutes and share slides; I will lead the runtime demo and handle live questions for the bulk of the session.
2) CTO from Acme can join for the first ~25 minutes as requested. We'll reserve the last 10 minutes for bespoke architecture questions.
3) Camila & Marcus can run a separate 30-minute prebrief at 9:30 AM PDT Sep 1 for any CT O-level concerns; we can record the prebrief and share notes.

If you need the CTO present for the entire hour, we can offer Sep 2 at 10:00 AM PDT but I understand that may not align with your travel.

On a related note: please confirm whether you want the session recorded and whether we should share post-demo logs/sample traces in advance.

Camila Reyes
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachment: agenda_v2.pdf - application/pdf)

Thanks all — that plan works. Confirming: move main demo to Wed Sep 1, 11:00 AM PDT. CTO will join at 11:00 for ~25–30 minutes, then depart for travel. We'll take the last 10 minutes for follow-ups and then schedule a deeper technical sync if needed. Please record the session and share the recording + any sample traces.

We'd like the 9:30 AM prebrief with your engineering leads — schedule that as a separate calendar item and send invite to priya.shah and ops.

Appreciate the flexibility; see you Wednesday.

Priya
